subject: Bezalel Smotrich
topic: Freeze of NIS 200m grant for Arab local authorities
resolution_notes: Unresolved-first recheck recovered the official Knesset Finance Committee record confirming that on 2023-09-26 the NIS 200m allocation for Arab local authorities was approved, with transfer conditioned on an oversight mechanism. This strengthens the later-outcome chronology but still supplies no court, State Comptroller, inquiry or equivalent finding of a concrete personal governance failure by Smotrich. Preserve Pending; do not infer wrongdoing from the freeze itself.
